signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch-style house frontage with front lawn, stone wall, and driveway.
signals.notes: Olive-green sided ranch with brick chimney and attached garage; a dark hatchback is parked in the driveway, and the front has a mix of mowed lawn and informal, unkempt-looking plantings along a dry-stacked stone wall that suggest homeowner upkeep.
